captured_note: Ported from the capture's self-contained methods/6_rotation_prediction, whose models/alexnet_rotation.py and data/rotation_dataset.py are the lab's own implementation of Gidaris et al. (2018), following the official RotNet AlexNet-BN, torch/torchvision only. So it ports self-contained (no third_party submodule), the treatment the other re-implemented methods received. The capture directory number (6) equals this method's number in the Step 1&2 list (see docs/PORTING_ROADMAP.md).

paper.title: Unsupervised Representation Learning by Predicting Image Rotations

encoder: encoder.pt is the AlexNet-BN feature extractor (encoder.*): the five convolutional blocks and the two FC blocks, producing a 4096-d feature per image. The 4-class rotation head (classifier.*) is pretext machinery and is excluded.
linear_eval: Reads the trained encoder.pt and probes the AlexNet-BN encoder's 4096-d feature (images resized to the encoder's training input size), a genuine learned representation -- so the number is comparable. Follows the lab's ARSSL probe (L2-normalise + mean-centre, single linear layer, SGD momentum + cosine, top1/top5). The capture's research eval could select an earlier conv layer; the port fixes the representation at the trained encoder's output for a single comparable number, as in every other self-contained port here.
rewritten_during_the_port: an AdaptiveAvgPool2d((6, 6)) is added before the FC block so the encoder accepts any input size; at the paper's 224px input the pool5 map is already 6x6, so the pool is an identity there and only matters for the smaller inputs a CPU smoke uses
the device is resolved (resolve_device) instead of assumed CUDA (the lab wrapper reached CUDA through DistributedDataParallel/setup_dist)
main() split into build_parser()/run(args, config) returning the pretext loss/accuracy and epoch count
the run is seeded through make_deterministic (python, numpy, torch)
the training loop drops the upstream DistributedDataParallel and the TensorBoard logging so the same step runs on a CPU or a GPU unchanged

the capture's Step 2 (unified ViT-B/16 rotation, from scratch) IS ported here as the pilot for the Step-2 comparison: models/vit_rotation.py (timm VisionTransformer built with num_classes=0 as the encoder.* backbone, plus a separate 4-way rotation head), train_pretrain_vit_rotation.py (AdamW + linear-warmup/cosine + grad-clip + AMP on CUDA, checkpointing at save_at_epochs 100/200/300), and configs/pretrain_vit.yaml (arch: vit); it is selected by the config's arch key, so the native AlexNet pretrain and the contract stages/metrics (ImageNet linear probe) are unchanged, and timm is pulled in only on the arch: vit path. The DDP/torchrun launch is dropped as in every port
DATA_ROOT is the dataset root; the pretrain stage reads its train/ subdirectory (unified data-root convention via adapterlib.dataset_split_dir).

step1_native_artifact.acquisition: Obtain this exact checkpoint from its owner, then use bin/fetch-weights.py --artifact step1_native_artifact --source to verify its SHA-256. No public download URL is verified.
